prompts.ashtownConceptPrompt: Create a master zoning concept for Ashtown, a fictional Ontario town of approximately 5000 detached homes. Landscape 3:2 strict overhead orthographic municipal map, elegant rich natural land texture beneath clean pale yellow residential zoning and narrow gray streets. The memorable town centre is a LARGE central public green, a grand church campus on its northeast edge, and a large lively market district with market hall and pedestrian square on its west edge. Around that centre, organic varied neighbourhoods with interconnected looping streets, crescents, diagonal old-town streets, winding collectors and some short straight avenues, NOT a regular grid and NOT concentric cloned rings. Ten pink school campuses distributed through neighbourhoods. A blue industrial/employment area on the southeast periphery served by a bypass. Green park fingers, small wooded creeks, agricultural fields and forest fringe outside the town. Two major diagonally crossing collector corridors curve around the central pedestrian green rather than cutting through it. About ten distinct neighbourhood districts at sensible similar density, with connected roads and multiple exits, fine lot divisions suggesting housing capacity but do not draw individual houses or pools yet. No solar, no words, no labels, no border, no UI. Large town much denser and wider than a 500-home village. High craftsmanship like a Whitby zoning map, not a diagram.
prompts.ashtownRoofPrompt: Production game asset atlas: EXACT straight-down 90-degree orthographic aerial ROOFS ONLY, like satellite imagery. Twelve different rectangular detached house rooftops in a precise 4-column by 3-row grid on a 1536x1024 transparent canvas. Each cell 384x341. Each roof centered with generous transparent margins, fills about 270x270 pixels. Entire roofs are rectangles and face straight up, no rotation, no facades at all, no front walls, no perspective, no sky, no ground. Rich realistic architectural detail: asphalt shingles, gable ridges, hips, a few dormers, chimneys, flashing, guttering. Variety of charcoal slate, brown, weathered gray, warm red tile and muted green roofs, Canadian detached homes. All roofs are truly viewed from directly above with horizontal/vertical eaves parallel to image edges. Tiny gentle shadows on roof itself. No solar panels, no pools, no yards, no text. This will be placed inside geometrically measured building footprints in a town map. Render extremely sharp clean detail.
